ident_mandate_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 mandate
ident_mandate_intro: If you found this address inside a file, that file is a mandate: rules that say what an AI agent may do in a household.
ident_audit_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 audit log entry
ident_audit_intro: If you found this address inside a file, the file holds entries of an audit log: the record of what agents asked for and what was decided, linked into a hash chain.
ident_audit_v1_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 audit log entry of version 1
ident_audit_v1_intro: If you found this address inside a file, the file holds entries of an audit log, written in version 1 of the format. Version 1 is version 0 with more events, among them certificates, Certificate Transparency, remote access and relays. Entries of both versions can stand in the same log, linked into one hash chain.
ident_checkpoint_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 audit log checkpoint
ident_checkpoint_intro: This address names the signed statement of a checkpoint: proof that an audit log had a certain entry at a certain position, so later changes are noticed.
ident_mandate_meta_title: Identifier of the mandate format v0
ident_audit_meta_title: Identifier of the audit log entry format v0
ident_audit_v1_meta_title: Identifier of the audit log entry format v1
ident_checkpoint_meta_title: Identifier of the audit checkpoint format v0
ident_spec_body: The section that defines this format in detail.
ident_play_body: Open and test a mandate in your browser.
ident_how_body: Why the log is a hash chain, explained without jargon.
ident_relay_metadata_title: This address identifies the metadata of a relay operator under the Home-Mandate Relay Specification v0
ident_relay_metadata_intro: If you found this address in a file, the file describes a relay operator: its domains, the addresses of its relay, the certificate authorities it allows and the protection levels. A gateway reads it before it pairs with the operator.
ident_relay_metadata_meta_title: Identifier of the relay metadata v0
ident_relay_enrollment_title: This address identifies the pairing messages under the Home-Mandate Relay Specification v0
ident_relay_enrollment_intro: This address holds the JSON Schema of the messages with which a gateway pairs with a relay operator, obtains its certificates and unpairs again.
ident_relay_enrollment_meta_title: Identifier of the pairing messages v0
ident_relay_spec_body: The section that defines this format in detail.
ident_relay_implement_body: Conformance classes, test tool and downloads for operators and gateways.
